top_choice_rationale: P001 (Mircea Cărtărescu, single writer, one prize part) is my choice on the common criteria, not because all six round-2 files name him, which is not evidence of merit. His voice is distinctive and recognisable. Blinding (Orbitor) and Solenoid, as publicly described, build memory, the body and dream into a sustained metaphysical project, with formal architecture on a large scale. The poetic origin and essays suggest an authorship rather than one celebrated book. The principal reservation is unresolved: whether the very large late volumes deepen the project or only enlarge it by repeating motifs. Others are translation loss of the long Romanian syntax and rhythm, and thinner coverage of the poetry, essays and early prose. These argue for a citation that names the volumes it relies on and leads with the prose, and I judge the cycles as wholes. They do not justify P000, since I see no merit or citation reason to withhold an award from an oeuvre of this scale and distinctiveness. My assessment rests on public knowledge only, without fresh reading or independent verification. This models a committee recommendation, not the decision of the full Swedish Academy.
